messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

We need to compute speed after first 10 seconds given distance 120 m, starting from rest, constant acceleration? It says "汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離" implies constant acceleration? Usually yes. So we can compute acceleration a = 2s / t^2? Actually distance s = 0.5 a t^2. So a = 2s / t^2 = 2*120 / 100 = 240/100 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed v = a t = 2.4*10 = 24 m/s. So speed after first part is 24 m/s.

Then second part: accelerate for 5 seconds from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed? Wait: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" The initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s? But earlier we had 24 m/s. Maybe they mean initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s? But that contradicts previous. Let's parse: "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。" So after first part, speed is 24 m/s. Then second stage: accelerate 5 seconds, starting from 12 m/s? That seems inconsistent. Maybe they mean the initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s? But that would be less than 24 m/s. Maybe they mis-specified: maybe the initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s? But then final speed is twice the initial speed of second stage, so final speed = 24 m/s. But that equals the speed at end of first part. That would mean no acceleration? But they say accelerate 5 seconds. Something wrong.

Alternatively, maybe they mean: after first part, speed is 24 m/s. Then second stage: accelerate 5 seconds, starting from 12 m/s? That would mean the car slows down? Not possible. So second stage final speed is 48 m/s. They also say "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍". Maybe they mean initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s? But that would be half of 24 m/s. But maybe they mis-specified: maybe the car's speed at start of second stage is 12 m/s? But that would be less than 24 m/s. So maybe the car decelerated? Not likely.

Let's interpret: The car after first part has speed 24 m/s. Then second stage: accelerate for 5 seconds, starting from 12 m/s? That would be weird. Maybe they meant the car's acceleration is such that after 5 seconds, its speed is twice the initial speed of the first part (i.e., 48 m/s). But they also mention 12 m/s as initial speed of second stage? Could be a mistake. Let's assume the second stage starts at 12 m/s and ends at 48 m/s after 5 seconds. Then acceleration a = (v - u)/t = (48-12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2. That seems plausible.

But if the car's speed at start of second stage is 12 m/s, that contradicts the first part. But maybe the car slowed down from 24 m/s to 12 m/s before second stage? Not mentioned.
